name: What is the typical timeline for a kitchen cabinet replacement project?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeline for a kitchen cabinet replacement project?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for kitchen cabinet replacement can range from a few weeks to several months, primarily depending on the type of cabinets chosen and the complexity of the installation. Stock cabinets have the shortest lead time, while custom cabinets can take 6-12 weeks for manufacturing alone. Once cabinets arrive, installation usually takes 3-7 days. This timeline does not include the initial design consultation, measurement, and ordering process. We coordinate carefully to minimize disruption and keep your project on schedule.
acceptedAnswer.description: A typical kitchen cabinet replacement can take 3 weeks to several months, with custom cabinets having longer lead times. Installation generally takes 3-7 days after cabinet arrival.
